gateNotes.comment: `cargo xtask ci` is the single definition of green (fmt, web, clippy, layers, test, panic_hunt, doctest, wasm) and must pass after every task (golden rule 8). Inside a task prefer the focused commands below, then run the full gate once before moving the task to done.
gateNotes.focusedFrontend: cd apps/pistudiodashboard && npm run check && npm run lint && npm test
gateNotes.ui: cd apps/pistudiodashboard && npm run snapshot -- --out <file>.png (look at the image, both themes) — golden rule 5
gateNotes.typecheck: covered by `npm run check` inside the gate's web step
